Class DEditXMLWindow

java.lang.Object
  |
  +--model.DEditXMLWindow
public final class DEditXMLWindow
extends java.lang.Object

Class which represents a window for editing the XML tree but also contains it's text frame and a number of other features. It is essentially the graphical and logical components of an opened XML file from the perspective of the editor.

DEditXMLWindow

public DEditXMLWindow(model.DEditor owner,
                      javax.swing.JDesktopPane jdp,
                      model.DEditSchema schema,
                      java.lang.String filename,
                      model.DEditTreeCellRenderer renderer,
                      org.w3c.dom.Document document,
                      java.awt.event.MouseListener[] mls,
                      model.DEditPlugin plugin)
Creates a DEditXMLWindow for an existing file by opening it as for a new file then changing the relevant information.

Parameters:
owner - the DEditor this DEditXMLWindow belongs to
jdp - the JDesktopPane that this DEditXMLWindow's JInternalFrames will appear in
schema - the DEditSchema used for this DEditXMLWindow (and all others as well)
filename - the name of the file that produced document
renderer - the DEditTreeCellRenderer that will be used to render the JTree in this DEditXMLWindow
document - the DOM Document currently open
mls - MouseListeners to install into treeFrame

DEditXMLWindow

public DEditXMLWindow(model.DEditor owner,

Creates a DEditXMLWindow by setting up it's appropriate JInternalFrames and installing MouseListeners and a (DEdit)TreeCellRenderer.

Parameters:

schema - the DEditSchema used for this DEditXMLWindow (and all others as well)

document - the DOM Document currently open
mls - MouseListeners to install into treeFrame
